title: rvtk 0.2.0
text: use_rvtk(): one-call downstream package setup. new usethis-style helper configures downstream R package link VTK one step. Running rvtk::use_rvtk() inside downstream package project: Adds rvtk Imports field DESCRIPTION. Writes src/Makevars backtick-style Rscript invocations query tools/configure.R compiler linker flags. Writes src/Makevars.win Windows-specific $(shell ...) syntax . Writes tools/configure.R calls rvtk::CppFlags() rvtk::LdFlagsFile() customisable list VTK modules. Adds src/vtk_libs.rsp .gitignore. Creates R/rvtk_imports.R minimal @importFrom rvtk tag R CMD check warn unused Imports entry. modules argument (default: standard /O + core set) lets downstream developers restrict linking VTK modules need, avoiding unintended symbol drag-(important macOS static bundles). Uses cli formatted console output (listed Imports). Linux x86_64 musl (Alpine Linux) support. pre-built static fallback now provides vtk-X.Y.Z-linux-musl-x86_64.tar.gz archive built inside Alpine 3.22 container via docker run GitHub Actions runner (container: job directive used GitHub Actions’ Node.js runtime glibc-linked crashes musl). configure script detects musl inspecting ldd --version output automatically downloads correct archive; user action required. fixes installation CRAN musl check platform (x86_64-pc-linux-musl, Alpine Linux). following extra CMake flags set musl build avoid X11 rendering dependencies unavailable headless Alpine runner: -DVTK_USE_X=-DVTK_MODULE_ENABLE_VTK_RenderingOpenGL2=. Linux aarch64 support. pre-built static fallback now provides vtk-X.Y.Z-linux-aarch64.tar.gz archive built ubuntu-24.04-arm. configure script detects host architecture downloads correct archive automatically, user action required.

title: rvtk 0.1.1
text: planned CRAN submission v0.1.0 cancelled downstream package developers reported linker errors building pre-built Windows VTK libraries. Two root causes identified fixed: Wrong toolchain. Windows VTK zip compiled Rtools45 UCRT64 toolchain (/ucrt64/bin/gcc), uses dynamic C runtime emits DLL-import symbols (__imp_fseeko64, __imp_ftello64, …). However, R CMD INSTALL links R packages x86_64-w64-mingw32.static.posix toolchain, fully static. mismatch caused undefined references nanosleep64, ftime64, __imp_fseeko64, __imp_ftello64. GitHub Actions workflow now builds Windows VTK zip x86_64-w64-mingw32.static.posix compiler, matching toolchain downstream packages use. Command-line length overflow. full set VTK -l linker flags exceeds 8 191-character Windows command-line limit, causing linker silently drop flags end list. new function LdFlagsFile(path) writes flags response file returns short @path token GNU ld LLVM lld support. Downstream packages call LdFlagsFile('src/vtk_libs.rsp') configure / configure.win script instead LdFlags().

title: rvtk 0.1.1

Windows system libraries appended PKG_LIBS reduced -lgdi32 ; UCRT64-specific -lwinpthread -lmingwex -lucrtbase flags longer needed static.posix sysroot resolves POSIX symbols internally. README updated document LdFlagsFile(), explain rationale, provide unified configure example valid platforms, correct Windows toolchain description.
